name: Knot & Pine
description: A restored historic barn in Alpine, originally a bronzing forge, with a 4,500 sq ft dark-wood event space, mountain views, a bridal suite, a groom's loft, and tables and chairs for up to 120 guests, blending rustic and modern features.

Features > Bridal room.wording: Bridal suite with vanity and full-length mirror

Features > Event coordinator.wording: Event hostess from one hour before through the event

Decor > Greenery / florals.wording: Fresh Table Greenery $79 for 6ft, min of 4

Other > Cake table.wording: Two buffet tables and a cake table.

items.label: Description
items.value: A restored historic barn in Alpine, originally a bronzing forge, with a 4,500 sq ft dark-wood event space, mountain views, a bridal suite, a groom's loft, and tables and chairs for up to 120 guests, blending rustic and modern features.

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Venue rental (all-day setup access from 10am plus a 6-hour event block that includes cleanup; tables and chairs for up to 120; bridal suite and groom's loft; prep kitchen; string and bistro lights; sound system with cordless mic) — Mon-Wed — $3,500
Same inclusions — Thu — $4,500
Same inclusions — Fri or Sat — $4,750
Ceremony fee (ceremony seating and reset to reception layout) — $100
Extra hours, up to midnight — $150/hour
Early access before 10am — $150
Alcohol fee — $400
Additional photo sessions — $100/hour indoor and outdoor, $50/hour outdoor only
Additional venue visits — $50/hour
Holidays — may incur additional fees (inquire)

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
$1,500 non-refundable deposit, applied to the total
Date change or cancellation allowed within 72 hours of booking
50% of remaining balance due 60 days before; final payment due 30 days before
Cancellation 60+ days out: 50% refund of balance (minus deposit); within 30 days: no refund

items.label: Bridal room
items.value: Bridal suite with vanity and full-length mirror

items.label: Rooms
items.value:
Bridal suite with vanity and full-length mirror
Groom's loft with lounge and TV

items.label: Event coordinator
items.value: Event hostess from one hour before through the event

items.label: Included items
items.value:
10 farm-style wood guest tables (96 in.)
80-120 cross-back wood chairs
2 buffet tables
Cake table
Indoor and outdoor string and bistro lights
Chandeliers
Double-door entrance

items.label: Staff & coordination
items.value: Event hostess on site 1 hour before and during the event (assists with setup and guest needs)

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value:
Included: general venue cleaning by venue staff
Couple or vendors remove decorations and rented items

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Yes
Hi-fi Bluetooth sound system with speakers
Cordless microphone

items.label: Greenery / florals
items.value: Fresh Table Greenery $79 for 6ft, min of 4

items.label: For rent
items.value:
Full-service fresh greenery package (ceiling draping, chandelier and door greenery, 10 table packages, 2 food-table garlands) — $2,600
Candle package — $30 per table
Table package (candle package, chiffon runner, 6 ft faux garland) — $65 per table
Ceiling and wall draping — $700
Fresh table greenery — $79 (6 ft, min. 4), $169 (12 ft, min. 2), $303 (20 ft)
Fresh greenery table package — $110 per table
Barn door decor — $300 Christmas trees, $470 fresh mixed greens, $150 twinkle lights drape, $225 curtains
Long chiffon table runners — $15 each
Chandelier garland with fresh mixed greens — $470
Wooden arch backdrop — $200

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Mountain views
Restored historic building (originally a bronzing forge)
Complimentary one-hour photo session
One complimentary walkthrough

items.label: Full Service Fresh Greenery
items.value: Price: $2,600 · Includes: ceiling draping; chandeliers; doors; 10 table packages; 2 food table garlands

items.label: Candle Package
items.value: Price: $30 per table · Includes: 4 tall clear glass votives with tea lights; 4 floating candles in vase; 4 glass votives

items.label: Table Package
items.value: Price: $65 per table · Includes: candle package; long chiffon runner; 6 ft faux garland or faux flower garland

items.label: Fresh Greenery Table Package
items.value: Price: $110 per table · Includes: candle package; long chiffon runner; 6 ft fresh greenery garland

items.label: Barn door options
items.value: Price: $300 Christmas trees / $470 fresh mixed greens / $150 twinkle lights drape / $225 pulled-back curtains / $225 straight-down curtains

items.label: Cake table
items.value: Two buffet tables and a cake table.

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Open vendor policy; any caterer
Preferred caterers listed: Bliss Catering, Crisp Catering
No extra fee for using outside vendors

items.label: Alcohol
items.value:
Allowed with $400 alcohol fee
Must be served by an approved licensed bartender (Copa Bar Service or The Bar Project)
No outside alcohol or bartenders

items.label: Times
items.value:
Setup access from 10am on the event day (earlier for $150)
6-hour event block starting when the event begins (includes cleanup)
Events end by 10pm unless extended (up to midnight)

items.label: Rental length
items.value: 6-hour event block plus all-day setup access; extendable to midnight at $150/hour

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
Events end by 10pm unless extended (up to midnight)
Music turned down at 10pm (city code)
Lit candles only in enclosed cylinder glass vases; none on the floor during the reception
Decorations and adhesives must not damage the venue
Tables and chairs may not be removed from the venue
No outside alcohol or bartenders

items.label: Payments
items.value: 50% of remaining balance 60 days before; final payment 30 days before

items.label: Cancellation
items.value: free change/cancel within 72 hours of booking; 60+ days out: 50% refund of balance minus deposit; within 30 days: non-refundable

items.label: Accessibility
items.value: Venue states it is fully accessible for guests with disabilities

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Pricing page lists one rate per day group with no year; the separate 2026 and 2027 rate tables in the old data are no longer on the site
Holidays may cost more (inquire)
Sister venue: 5th East Hall in American Fork
